Title: Submit feedback with valid name, email, and message
Preconditions: User is on the feedback page, no prior data entered
Steps:
Given Given the feedback form is displayed
When When the user enters "John Doe" in the Name field
When And enters "john.doe@example.com" in the Email field
When And enters "Great app, keep it up!" in the Message field

Then And the form fields are cleared
Expected Result: Feedback is recorded and user receives confirmation
